gloss: beginning; opening; start of an era

definitions.gloss: raising of the curtain; opening of a performance
definitions.explanation: The literal raising of the curtain at the start of a theatrical performance.

definitions.gloss: beginning; start; dawn of a new era
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, the start of something significant such as a new period, movement, or chapter in history.

examples.japanese: {幕開|まくあ}けは{午後|ごご}6{時|じ}だ。
{幕開|まくあ}けから{観客|かんきゃく}を{引|ひ}きつける{舞台|ぶたい}だった。
examples.english: It was a performance that captivated the audience from the opening.

examples.japanese: {華|はな}やかな{演出|えんしゅつ}で{幕開|まくあ}けを{飾|かざ}った。
examples.english: The opening was adorned with a spectacular production.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{時代|じだい}の{幕開|まくあ}けだ。
examples.english: It is the dawn of a new era.

examples.japanese: この{発明|はつめい}が{産業革命|さんぎょうかくめい}の{幕開|まくあ}けとなった。
examples.english: This invention marked the beginning of the industrial revolution.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{近代化|きんだいか}の{幕開|まくあ}けは{明治維新|めいじいしん}にさかのぼる。
examples.english: The dawn of Japan's modernization can be traced back to the Meiji Restoration.

notes:
USAGE:
{幕開|まくあ}け originally refers to the raising of a theater curtain. It is now widely used figuratively to mean the start of a significant new period or era.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幕開|まくあ}けを{飾|かざ}る (to mark the opening)
- {新|あたら}しい{時代|じだい}の{幕開|まくあ}け (the dawn of a new era)
- {幕開|まくあ}けとなる (to serve as the beginning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{開幕|かいまく} also means the start of a performance or event but is more commonly used for sports seasons, festivals, or formal events. {幕開|まくあ}け is preferred for figurative uses describing historical or cultural turning points.
